g: air conditioner size, how big ac, ac size, ac tonnage, btu per square foot, sq ft, cooling size

t: What is a ton of cooling
a: One ton of cooling = 12,000 BTU/h ≈ 3.517 kW, the heat needed to melt one short ton of ice in 24 hours.

a: COP = heat delivered / electrical power. Air-source heat pumps run COP 2–4 in mild weather, lower when it is very cold. HSPF is the seasonal heating figure (BTU/Wh).
